tool_args.rationale: Fresh confirmation refuted the ad hoc concave-power fit, but did not show chaotic oscillations. The supplied archive gives a directly relevant two-layer siphon law with gradient inhibition and a signed square-root branch term, which matches the bridge-supply and flux-conservation signatures. Fit its three target parameters numerically to all supplied rows and let fresh confirmation determine whether this stationary mechanism holds.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed rows support a static siphon law; this batch is specifically needed to identify an RK4 memory ODE with adequate trajectory coverage.
Existing branch readings already vary s_grad substantially and show sink inhibition; another measurement is lower value than testing the explicit source-inland-hub mechanism.
All paid rows share H=0.6 and there is no temporal reversal evidence; these models require horizon-varying or trajectory probes.
